title: public form (console FormPage): a loaded app translation bundle's object field label overrides the form entry's own label, so a visitor reads the agent-side label whenever the browser holds the bundle
body:
repo:hotcrm#1 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5

Priority p2. Found on hotcrm#2531, on a hosted tenant running 18.5. Read in the code at `@object-ui/console@18.5.0`; the code is the same on main.

**What happens.** HotCRM's public support form gives two entries visitor-facing labels. The form entry says `label: 'Your name'`, and the zh-CN pack has `_sections.how_can_we_help.fields.supplied_name.label = '您的姓名'`. The object field's own label is the agent-side 提交人姓名. `GET /api/v1/forms/support` serves the entry label correctly (您的姓名) on hosted and locally.
- On a hosted walk, the rendered page read **提交人姓名 / 提交人邮箱**.
- A fresh anonymous browser on a local 18.5.0 dev server read 您的姓名 / 您的邮箱.

**Cause (code reading).** `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx`:
- `buildSections` (:855) builds the row label as `localized(override.label ?? def.label)`. The entry label wins, which is correct.
- The render site (:3302) then prints `fieldLabel(loaded.object, f.name, f.label)`.
- `fieldLabel` (`ui/packages/i18n/src/useObjectLabel.ts:404`) resolves the client bundle key `fields.<object>.<field>` first. It falls back to the served row label only on a miss.

So whenever the browser holds the app's translation bundle, the **object field** translation overlays the **entry** label. A visitor who is signed in to the same console, or any visit where the bundle is loaded, reads the agent-side label. A cold anonymous visit with no bundle reads the entry label. That is why one hosted walk and one local probe disagree on the same 18.5 code. The same `fieldLabel(object, f.name, f.label)` also builds the required-field and visibleWhen-fault messages (:2820, :2838, :2846), so those messages name the field by the wrong label too.

**Ask.** When a form entry declares its own `label`, the public form uses it as served, already localized by the form endpoint. The bundle overlay applies only to a row whose label came from the object field. Pin it with a public-form test that loads an app bundle that translates the object field.

**Re-check.** Sign in to the console, open `/_console/f/support` in the same browser in zh-CN, and read the first two labels.

hotcrm#2531 waits on this card.
